$comment: Independent human-authored peer authorities for the RPC client request plan. ORESoftware/api-docs owns the generator and the option catalog that produces plans; this registry entry owns the fleet-shared TypeSpec peer so plan shape is not defined solely inside one consumer. Generated schemas and generated clients remain evidence, never a third authority.
name: rpc-client-plan-v1
notes: The kind discriminator carries the unary/streaming split: a unary plan must not carry stream shaping and a streaming plan must not carry unary-only shaping. Cross-field rules (the surface split, mutually exclusive rate shaping, backoff requires a retry budget) are authored in both peers: allOf in JSON Schema, @extension("allOf") in TypeSpec.
